title: Objectives and key results
description: Make objectives measurable with key results and review progress against them.

sources.title: What Matters, What is an OKR?

rules.instruction: For each OKR, pair the objective with measurable results. Define a baseline, target, due date and measurement owner for each result.
rules.verification: Ask the owner to reproduce the baseline and explain how hitting the target would demonstrate progress toward the objective.

rules.instruction: At the review date, record progress using the agreed measure and explain changes in assumptions. Ask the decision owner which work to continue, adjust or stop.
rules.verification: Compare the updated result with the baseline and previous review. Confirm that any change to a metric definition or target has a recorded decision.
